description: This file defines a React component named DatasetPanel used for displaying dataset columns, handling loading states, errors, and existing dataset alerts within the Superset frontend. It includes styled components, constants, and functions related to dataset display and interaction.

classes.name: StyledHeaderProps
classes.description: Interface defining properties for styled header component, specifically the position type.

classes.name: EPosition
classes.description: Enum for CSS position options: absolute and relative.

methods.name: renderExistingDatasetAlert
methods.description: Renders an informational alert when a dataset already exists for the table, with a link to view the dataset.
